resources.string: Save an address for a service you choose. Saving an address does not sign you in or contact its server.
Remove this saved address from this device?
Address saved. Not connected or enrolled.
Use a name of 1–64 characters and an HTTPS origin without a username, password, path, query or fragment.
That service address is already saved.
You can save up to eight service addresses.
Preferences could not be read. Existing data has been kept.
The change could not be saved. Try again.
Use a sealed configuration file and its opening code from an operator you trust. No account is needed.
This deletes the configuration from this phone and ends its connection. To use it again, import the file with its opening code.
Use the separate code from your operator. Ito encrypts the configuration with Android Keystore and does not retain this code.
Connect uses the network chosen here.
Connect captures this network. A default network change ends the connection. Physical choices require a default route without a VPN applied to Ito; change a previous choice explicitly.
Sends random bytes through this service to an echo destination.
The bounded test sends random bytes through the selected authenticated service to an echo destination. Your server must authorize that destination. It never tries a direct connection after a failure.
Your calling identity can\'t be opened
The stored identity is damaged. Ito has kept it unchanged and will not create a new one over it.
The Android Keystore key that protects your identity is missing. Ito has kept the stored data and will not replace it.
Your identity could not be read right now. Nothing was changed. Try again.
This phone gets its own key for calls. Contacts recognize you by it.

This phone gets its own key for calls. Contacts recognize you by it. It stays on this phone and is not backed up, so clearing app data or reinstalling means creating a new one and verifying contacts again.
This code is public. Share it any way you like, then compare fingerprints before you call.
QR code of your contact code
No contacts yet. Add one with their contact code.
Connect to your relay service before you call.
Enter or scan the contact\'s public code. A new contact stays unverified until you compare fingerprints.
Compare every group with the fingerprint on your contact\'s phone, side by side or over a channel you already trust. A partial match is not enough.
Ito shows a one-time invitation for your contact to scan.
Ito will refuse calls with this key. The record stays so a call from it is never trusted again.
This contact moved to a new key. Calls use the new key once you verify it.
This key replaces an older one. Verify it before calling, even if you verified the old key.
Use this only when %1$s tells you, outside Ito, that they have a new phone or identity. The old key is blocked and the new one must be verified.
The change could not be made. Nothing was saved.
That is not a valid Ito contact code.
Use a name of 1 to 128 bytes.
That is your own contact code.
The fingerprint did not match. The contact is still not verified.
This phone already holds the most contacts it can.
The change could not be saved. Your contacts are unchanged.
That code is not a valid Ito invitation.
That code belongs to a different key. The contact is still not verified.
Point the camera at the invitation on your contact\'s phone. Ito uses the camera only while this screen is open, and the images stay on this phone.
Point the camera at your contact\'s code. Ito uses the camera only while you scan, and the images stay on this phone.
Ito can\'t scan without the camera. You can allow it now or in Android settings.
Let %1$s scan this code with Ito. It works once and expires within five minutes.
Show this only to your contact, in person. Anyone who scans it can try to join this call, so don\'t photograph, screenshot or send it.
This caller proved they hold your verified contact\'s key. Answer within 30 seconds.
End-to-end encrypted. Your contact proved their identity.
The other side ended before proving who it was. This does not show your contact declined.
The call timed out or its invitation expired.
Ito could not confirm your contact\'s identity, so the call stopped.
The invitation is invalid, expired or already used. Ask for a new one.
Ito cannot trust the device clock, so it refused the call. Your identity and contacts are preserved.
The connection to the call service was lost.
Connect to your relay service first, on the Service tab.
Ito could not save the call\'s record, so it stopped. Your contacts are unchanged.
Another call or invitation is still in progress.
Audio could not start. Check microphone permission and the call connection.
Keeps the authorized encrypted call available for microphone and playback.
Unlock to see your contacts and settings.
Ask for your screen lock or a strong biometric each time you open Ito. A call in progress keeps running while Ito is locked.
Authorize access to Ito’s local data.
Local protection is unavailable. Existing encrypted data is preserved. Restore device authentication or retry. Ito will not replace your keys.
This call was not saved to local history. Local data may be locked or unavailable.
Provider support is not included in this build. Select a manual configuration to connect.
Ito uses this connection only for its own calls. It is not a VPN for other apps.
No usable network. Check your connection and try again.
The network changed or was lost, so the connection ended.
The server name could not be found. Check your network.
The server refused the connection or could not be authenticated.
The configuration file is invalid or does not match this app.
Ito could not read its saved connection data.
Your provider access is not valid. Check Services below.
The connection ended unexpectedly. Your choice is unchanged.
Connected. You can call your contacts.
Show network choices, server addresses and connection tests. Security and privacy settings stay the same.
Connect on the Service tab to call.
Turns on your microphone for this call.
Needs Android 11 or later and a screen lock. If Android loses the lock key, Ito keeps your data locked and never replaces your identity.
Relay service only. Calls always go through your YUME relay service, and direct calls are not available.
Standard quality, Opus at about 24 kbit/s. Lower-data modes are not available yet.
